option_relations.rationale: Meningitis is an inflammation of the meninges, typically caused by infection, and does not directly relate to Dandy-Walker Malformation.
Neurocysticercosis is a parasitic infection of the central nervous system, which is distinct from a congenital brain malformation like Dandy-Walker Malformation.
Ependymoma is a type of brain tumor, which is a neoplastic process, whereas Dandy-Walker Malformation is a congenital developmental anomaly.
Hemangioblastoma is a vascular tumor of the central nervous system, which is a neoplastic condition, distinct from the congenital malformation of Dandy-Walker Malformation.
